CacheEntry {\n    /// Cached JSON bytes (serialized MergedSearchResult).\n    data: Vec<u8>,\n    /// Expiration timestamp.\n    expires_at: Instant,\n}\n\nimpl CacheEntry {\n    /// Create a new efficient comparison while maintaining\n/// deterministic key generation for identical queries.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]\npub struct CacheKey {\n    /// Hash of the canonicalized components.\n    hash: u64,\n}\n\nimpl CacheKey {\n    /// Create a new cache key from the components.\n    ///\n    /// # Arguments\n    ///\n    /// * `index_name` - Target index UID\n    /// * `canonicalized_query_body` - Query JSON sorted deterministically\n    /// * `settings_version` - Index settings version (invalidates on schema change)\n    pub fn new(index_name: &str, canonicalized_query_body: &str, settings_version: u64) -> Self {\n        let mut hasher = DefaultHasher::new();\n        index_name.hash(&mut hasher);\n        canonicalized_query_body.hash(&mut hasher);\n        settings_version.hash(&mut hasher);\n        Self {\n            hash: hasher.finish(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Create a cache key for testing or special cases.\n    pub fn ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// LRU cache with TTL for merged search results.\npub struct ResultCache {\n    /// LRU cache backing store.\n    cache:    use std::num::NonZeroUsize;\n        let capacity = NonZeroUsize::new(config.max_size).unwrap_or_else(|| NonZeroUsize::new(1).unwrap());\n        let cache = lru::LruCache::new(capacity);\n        Self {\n            cache: Arc::new(RwLock::new(cache)),\n            config,\n            hits: Arc::new(RwLock::new(0)),\n            misses: Arc::new(RwLock::new(0)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Get a cached result if available and not expired.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(Some(data))` on cache hit, `Ok(None)` on miss,\n    /// or `Err` if the cache is disabled.\n    pub async fn get(&self, key: &CacheKey) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {\n        if !self.config.enabled {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n\n        let mut cache = self.cache.write().await;\n\n        if let Some(entry) = cache.get(key) {\n            if entry.is_expired() {\n                // Entry expired - remove it and return miss\n                cache.pop(key);\n                *self.misses.write().await += 1;\n                trace!(\"Cache expired for key {:?}\", key);\n                return Ok(None);\n            }\n\n            // Cache hit\n            *self.hits.write().await += 1;\n            debug!(\"Cache hit for key {:?}\", key);\n            Ok(Some(entry.data.clone()))\n        } else {\n            // Cache miss\n            *self.misses.write().await += 1;\n            trace!(\"Cache miss for key {:?}\", key);\n            Ok(None)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Insert a result into the cache.\n    ///\n    /// Returns Result<String> {\n    match query {\n        serde_json::Value::Object(map) => {\n            // Sort keys and recursively canonicalize values\n            let mut sorted_map = serde_json::Map::new();\n            let mut sorted_keys: Vec<&String> = map.keys().collect();\n            sorted_keys.sort();\n\n            for key in sorted_keys {\n                if let    );\n                }\n            }\n\n            Ok(serde_json::to_string(&sorted_map)?)\n        }\n        serde_json::Value::Array(arr) => {\n            // Canonicalize array elements\n            let canonicalized: Result<Vec<String>> = arr\n                .iter()\n                .map(|v| canonicalize_query(v))\n                .collect();\n            let canonical_arr: Ok(serde_json::to_string(&canonical_arr)?)\n        }\n        _ => {\n            // Primitive values (string, number, bool, null) are already canonical\n            Ok(serde_json::to_string(query)?)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Unit tests\n// query independently and returns results in input order.\n    /// Each query is executed via the provided executor function.\n    ///\n    /// Enforces both total_timeout_ms (for the entire batch) and per_query_timeout_ms\n    /// (for each individual query). A single slow query does not block others.\n    pub async fn execute<F, Fut>(\n        &self,\n        request: MultiSearchRequest,\n        mut executor: F,\n    ) -> Result<MultiSearchResponse>\n    where\n        F: FnMut(SearchQuery) -> Fut,\n        Fut: std::future::Future<Output = Result<SearchResultData>>,\n    {\n        self.validate(&request)?;\n\n        let total_timeout = Duration::from_millis(self.config.total_timeout_ms);\n        let per_query_timeout = Duration::from_millis(self.config.per_query_timeout_ms);\n        let query_count = request.queries.len();\n\n        // Execute all queries in parallel with per-query timeout\n        let mut tasks = Vec::with_capacity(query_count);\n        for query in request.queries {\n            let query_future = executor(query);\n            let timeout_future = async move {\n                match tokio::time::timeout(per_query_timeout, query_future).await {\n                    Ok(Ok(data)) => SearchResult::ok(data.body),\n                    Ok(Err(e)) => SearchResult::err(500, \"internal_error\", e.to_string()),\n                    Err(_) => SearchResult::timeout(),\n                }\n            };\n            tasks.push(timeout_future);\n        }\n\n        // Wait for all queries with total timeout\n        let results = match tokio::time::timeout(\n            total_timeout,\n            futures_util::future::join_all(tasks),\n        )\n        .await\n        {\n            Ok(r) => r,\n            Err(_) => {\n                // Total timeout exceeded - return timeout errors for all queries\n                return Ok(MultiSearchResponse {\n                    results: (0..query_count).map(|_| SearchResult::timeout()).collect(),\n                });\n            }\n        };\n\n        Ok(MultiSearchResponse { results })\n    }\n\n    /// Validate a multi-search request.\n    pub fn validate(&self, request: &MultiSearchRequest) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.config.max_queries_per_batch\n            )));\n        }\n\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for MultiSearchExecutor {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n the scenario described in miroir-yio:\n1868\t    /// - Shard 0: Normal (1,000 docs, term df = 100)\n1869\t    /// - Shard 1: 100x normal (100,000 docs, term df = 10,000)\n1870\t    /// - Shard 2: Near-empty (10 docs, term df = 1)\n1871\t    ///\n1872\t    /// Without global IDF preflight, each shard would compute different local IDF values:\n1873\t    /// - Shard 0: IDF ≈ log((1000 - 100 + 0.5) / (100 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n1874\t    /// - Shard 1: IDF ≈ log((100000 - 10000 + 0.5) / (10000 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n1875\t    /// - Shard 2: IDF ≈ log((10 - 1 + 0.5) / (1 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.8\n1876\t    ///\n1877\t    /// With global IDF preflight, all shards use the same IDF:\n1878\t    /// - Global: N = 101,010, df = 10,101\n1879\t    /// - IDF ≈ log((101010 - 10101 + 0.5) / (10101 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n1880\t    ///\n1881\t    /// This ensures scores are comparable across shards, enabling correct score-based merge.\n1882\t    #[tokio::test]\n1883\t    async fn test_dfs_skewed_shards_global_idf_aggregation() {\n1884\t        let mut topo = Topology::new(3, 1, 1);\n1885\t        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n1886\t NodeId::new(\"node-2\".into()),\n1897\t            \"http://node-2:7700\".into(),\n1898\t            0,\n1899\t        ));\n1900\t\n1901\t        let plan = plan_search_scatter(&topo, 0, 1, 3, None).await;\n1902\t\n1903\t        // Simulate severely skewed shard distribution\n1904\t        let mut c = MockNodeClient::default();\n1905\t\n1906\t        // Shard 0: Normal distribution\n1907\t        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n1908\t            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n1909\t            PreflightResponse {\n1910\t                total_docs: 1000,\n1911\t                avg_doc_length: 50.0,\n1912\t                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n1913\t                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 100 }),\n1914\t                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 80 }),\n1915\t                ]),\n1916\t            },\n1917\t        );\n1918\t\n1919\t        // Shard 1: 100x normal (severely skewed)\n1920\t        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n1921\t            NodeId::new(\"node-1\".into()),\n1922\t            PreflightResponse {\n1923\t                total_docs: 100_000,\n1924\t                avg_doc_length: 55.0,\n1925\t                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n1926\t                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 10_000 }),\n1927\t                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 8_000 }),\n1928\t                ]),\n1929\t            },\n1930\t        );\n1931\t\n1932\t        // Shard 2: Near-empty\n1933\t        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n1934\t            NodeId::new(\"node-2\".into()),\n1935\t            PreflightResponse {\n1936\t                total_docs: 10,\n1937\t                avg_doc_length: 45.0,\n1938\t                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n1939\t                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 1 }),\n1940\t                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 1 }),\n1941\t                ]),\n1942\t     terms: vec![\"machine\".into(), \"learning\".into()],\n1949\t            filter: None,\n1950\t        };\n1951\t\n1952\t        let global_idf = execute_preflight(&plan, &c, &preflight_req, &topo)\n1953\t            .await\n1954\t            .unwrap();\n1955\t\n1956\t        // Verify global aggregation\n1957\t        assert_eq!(global_idf.total_docs, 101_010);\n1958\t 10101.0 + 0.5) / (10101.0 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0;\n1965\t        let actual_idf_machine = global_idf.terms.get(\"machine\").unwrap().idf;\n1966\t        assert!((actual_idf_machine - expected_idf_machine).abs() < 0.001);\n1967\t\n1968\t        // Expected IDF for \"learning\": log((101010 - 8081 + 0.5) / (8081 + 0.5)) + 1\n1969\t        let expected_idf_learning: f64 =\n1970\t assert!((actual_idf_learning - expected_idf_learning).abs() < 0.001);\n1973\t\n1974\t        // Verify that without global IDF, local IDF values would differ significantly\n1975\t        // Shard 0 *term_df.entry(term.clone()).or_insert(0) += stats.df;\n            }\n        }\n\n        let avg_doc_length = if total_docs > 0 {\n            total_length / total_docs as f64\n        } else {\n            0.0\n        };\n\n        let n = total_docs as f64;\n        let terms = term_df\n            .into_iter()\n            .map(|(term, df)| {\n                let idf = if df == 0 {\n                    0.0\n                } else {\n                    ((n - df as f64 + 0.5) / (df as f64 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0\n                };\n                (term, GlobalTermStats { df, idf })\n            })\n            .collect();\n\n        Self {\n            total_docs,\n            avg_doc_length,\n            terms,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// for VectorMode {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::KeywordOnly\n    }\n}\n\nuse crate::vector::VectorSearchConfig;\n\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SearchRequest {\n    pub index_uid: body: Value,\n    /// Global IDF data from the preflight phase (OP#4).\n    pub global_idf: Option<GlobalIdf>,\n    /// Over-fetch factor for vector/hybrid search (plan §13.12).\n    /// For a request with limit L, each shard returns L × over_fetch_factor hits.\n    pub over_fetch_factor: u32,\n    /// Vector search mode (keyword-only, vector-only, or hybrid).\n    pub vector_mode: VectorMode,\n    /// Vector search configuration (for merge strategy).\n    pub vector_config: Option<VectorSearchConfig>,\n}\n\nimpl SearchRequest {\n    /// Build the request body for sending to a node.\n    ///\n    /// Injects `showRankingScore: true` unconditionally so the merger can global-sort.\n    /// Each node receives `offset + limit` results to ensure the coordinator has enough\n    /// data to apply pagination.\n    /// Build the request body for sending to a node.\n    ///\n    /// Injects `showRankingScore: true` unconditionally so the merger can global-sort.\n    /// Each node receives `offset + limit` results to ensure the coordinator has enough\n    /// data to apply pagination.\n    ///\n    /// For vector/hybrid queries, applies over-fetch factor (plan §13.12): each shard\n    /// returns `limit × over_fetch_factor` hits so the global reranker can recover\n    /// correct ordering on sparse semantic matches.\n    pub fn to_node_body(&self) -> Value {\n        let mut body = self.body.clone();\n\n        // Inject showRankingScore: true unconditionally for global sorting\n        body[\"showRankingScore\"] = serde_json::json!(true);\n\n        // For vector/hybrid search, apply over-fetch factor (plan §13.12)\n        let per_shard_limit = if self.vector_mode != VectorMode::KeywordOnly {\n            (self.offset + self.limit) * self.over_fetch_factor as usize\n        } else {\n            self.offset + self.limit\n        };\n        body[\"limit\"] = serde_json::json!(per_shard_limit);\n\n        // Set offset to 0 on individual nodes (coordinator handles offset)\n        body[\"offset\"] = serde_json::json!(0);\n\n        // Ensure query is set\n        if let Some(q) = &self.query {\n            body[\"q\"] = serde_json::json!(q);\n        }\n\n        // Ensure filter is set if provided\n        if let Some(filter) = &self.filter {\n            body[\"filter\"] = filter.clone();\n        }\n\n        // Ensure facets are set if provided\n        if let Some(facets) = &self.facets {\n            body[\"facets\"] = serde_json::json!(facets);\n        }\n\n        body\n    }\n\n    /// Detect the vector search mode from the request body.\n    ///\n    /// Returns VectorMode::Hybrid if the request has a `hybrid` field,\n    /// VectorMode::VectorOnly if it has `vector` field but no `q`,\n    /// KeywordOnly otherwise.\n    pub fn detect_vector_mode(body: &Value) -> VectorMode {\n        // Check for hybrid search (plan §13.12)\n        if body.get(\"hybrid\").is_some() {\n            return VectorMode::Hybrid;\n        }\n\n        // Check for pure vector search (has vector field, no query)\n        if body.get(\"vector\").is_some() {\n            if body\n                .get(\"q\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                .is_some_and(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            {\n                // Has both vector and query → hybrid\n                return VectorMode::Hybrid;\n            }\n            return VectorMode::VectorOnly;\n        }\n\n        // Check for _vectors (Meilisearch's stored vectors field)\n        if body.get(\"_vectors\").is_some() {\n            if body\n                .get(\"q\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                .is_some_and(|s| !s.is_empty())\n            {\n                return VectorMode::Hybrid;\n            }\n            return VectorMode::VectorOnly;\n        }\n\n        // Pure keyword search\n        VectorMode::KeywordOnly\n    }\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct ScatterResult {\n    pub shard_pages: async fn plan_search_scatter(\n    topology: &Topology,\n    query_seq: u64,\n    rf: usize,\n    shard_count: u32,\n    replica_selector: Option<&ReplicaSelector>,\n) -> ScatterPlan {\n    let chosen_group = crate::router::query_group_active(query_seq, topology);\n\n    let group = match topology.group(chosen_group) {\n        Some(g) => g,\n        None => {\n            return ScatterPlan {\n                chosen_group,\n                target_shards: Vec::new(),\n                shard_to_node: HashMap::new(),\n                deadline_ms: 0,\n                hedging_eligible: false,\n            };\n        }\n    };\n\n    let _covering = covering_set(shard_count, group, rf, query_seq);\n\n    let mut shard_to_node = HashMap::new();\n    let node_map = topology.node_map();\n\n    for shard_id in 0..shard_count {\n        let replicas = crate::router::assign_shard_in_group(shard_id, group.nodes(), rf);\n\n        // Filter to only healthy nodes within the group\n        let healthy_replicas: Vec<NodeId> = replicas\n            .iter()\n            .filter(|node_id| {\n                node_map\n                    .get(node_id)\n                    .map(|n| n.is_healthy())\n                    .unwrap_or(false)\n            })\n            .cloned()\n            .collect();\n\n        let selected = if !healthy_replicas.is_empty() {\n            // Use healthy intra-group replica\n            if let Some(selector) = replica_selector {\n                match selector.select(&healthy_replicas, chosen_group).await {\n                    Some(node) => node,\n                    None => healthy_replicas[(query_seq as usize) % healthy_replicas.len()].clone(),\n                }\n            } else {\n                healthy_replicas[(query_seq as usize) % healthy_replicas.len()].clone()\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Cross-group fallback: try other groups for this shard\n            let mut fallback_node = None;\n            'fallback: for group_id in 0..topology.replica_group_count() {\n                if group_id == chosen_group {\n                    continue;\n                }\n                if let Some(other_group) = topology.group(group_id) {\n                    let other_replicas =\n                        crate::router::assign_shard_in_group(shard_id, other_group.nodes(), rf);\n                    for other_node in other_replicas {\n                        if let Some(node) = node_map.get(&other_node) {\n                            if node.is_healthy() {\n                                fallback_node = Some(other_node);\n                                break 'fallback;\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n\n            fallback_node.unwrap_or_else(|| {\n                // No healthy node found anywhere - use original replica and let it fail\n                replicas[(query_seq as usize) % replicas.len()].clone()\n            })\n        };\n\n        shard_to_node.insert(shard_id, selected);\n    }\n\n    ScatterPlan {\n        chosen_group,\n        target_shards: (0..shard_count).collect(),\n        shard_to_node,\n        deadline_ms: 5000,\n        hedging_eligible: group.node_count() > 1,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Plan search scatter with query planner narrowing healthy_replicas[(query_seq as usize) % healthy_replicas.len()].clone()\n            }\n        } else {\n            // Cross-group fallback: try other groups for this shard\n            let mut  replica_selector: &ReplicaSelector,\n) -> ScatterPlan {\n    let chosen_group = crate::router::query_group_active(query_seq, topology);\n\n    let group = match topology.group(chosen_group) {\n        Some(g) => g,\n        None => {\n            return ScatterPlan {\n                chosen_group,\n                target_shards: Vec::new(),\n                shard_to_node: HashMap::new(),\n                deadline_ms: 0,\n                hedging_eligible: false,\n            };\n        }\n    };\n\n    // If the group has no nodes, return a plan with no targets\n    if group.nodes().is_empty() {\n        return ScatterPlan {\n            chosen_group,\n            target_shards: Vec::new(),\n            shard_to_node: HashMap::new(),\n            deadline_ms: 5000,\n            hedging_eligible: false,\n        };\n    }\n\n    let mut shard_to_node = HashMap::new();\n    for shard_id in 0..shard_count {\n        let replicas = crate::router::assign_shard_in_group(shard_id, group.nodes(), rf);\n        if replicas.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Use adaptive selection to pick the best replica\n        let selected = match replica_selector.select(&replicas, chosen_group).await {\n            Some(node) => node,\n            None => {\n                // Fallback to round-robin if selector returns None\n                replicas[(query_seq as usize) % replicas.len()].clone()\n            }\n        };\n\n        shard_to_node.insert(shard_id, selected);\n    }\n\n    ScatterPlan {\n        chosen_group,\n        target_shards: (0..shard_count).collect(),\n        shard_to_node,\n        deadline_ms: 5000,\n        hedging_eligible: group.node_count() > 1,\n    }\n}\n\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(node_count))]\npub async fn execute_scatter<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    policy: UnavailableShardPolicy,\n) -> Result<ScatterResult> {\n    let mut node_to_shards: HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u32>> = HashMap::new();\n    for (&shard_id, node_id) in &plan.shard_to_node {\n        if plan.target_shards.contains(&shard_id) {\n            node_to_shards\n                .entry(node_id.clone())\n                .or_default()\n                .push(shard_id);\n        }\n    }\n    tracing::Span::current().record(\"node_count\", node_to_shards.len());\n\n    let mut shard_pages = Vec::new();\n    let mut failed_shards = HashMap::new();\n    let mut deadline_exceeded = false;\n\n    let mut tasks = Vec::new();\n    for (node_id, shards) in node_to_shards {\n        let node = match topology.node(&node_id) {\n            Some(n) => n.clone(),\n            None => {\n                for shard_id in shards {\n                    failed_shards.insert(\n                        shard_id,\n                        NodeError::NetworkError(\"node not in topology\".to_string()),\n                    );\n                }\n                continue;\n            }\n        };\n        let client_ref = client;\n        let req_clone = req.clone();\n        let node_id_clone = node_id.clone();\n        let shard_count = shards.len();\n        // Create a span for this node's scatter call\n        let span = info_span!(\n            \"scatter_node\",\n            node_id = %node_id_clone,\n            address = %node.address,\n            shard_count = shard_count,\n        );\n        tasks.push(\n            async move {\n                let result = client_ref\n                    .search_node(&node_id_clone, &node.address, &req_clone)\n                    .await;\n                (node_id_clone, shards, result)\n            }\n            .instrument(span),\n        );\n    }\n\n    let results = futures_util::future::join_all(tasks).await;\n\n    for (_node_id, shards, result) in results {\n        match result {\n            Ok(body) => {\n                for _shard_id in shards {\n                    shard_pages.push(ShardHitPage { body: body.clone() });\n                }\n            }\n            Err(NodeError::Timeout) => {\n                deadline_exceeded = true;\n                for shard_id in shards {\n                    failed_shards.insert(shard_id, NodeError::Timeout);\n                }\n            }\n            Err(e) => {\n                for shard_id in shards {\n                    failed_shards.insert(shard_id, e.clone());\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let partial = !failed_shards.is_empty();\n\n    match policy {\n        UnavailableShardPolicy::Error => {\n            if !failed_shards.is_empty() {\n                return Err(crate::error::MiroirError::Routing(format!(\n                    \"{} shard(s) unavailable\",\n                    failed_shards.len()\n                )));\n            }\n        }\n        UnavailableShardPolicy::Partial => {}\n        UnavailableShardPolicy::Fallback => {\n            // Group-unavailability fallback: try other replica groups for failed shards\n            if !failed_shards.is_empty() {\n                let mut fallback_pages = Vec::new();\n                let mut remaining_failed = HashMap::new();\n\n                for (&shard_id, error) in &failed_shards {\n                    let mut fallback_succeeded = false;\n\n                    // Try each other replica group\n                    for group_id in 0..topology.replica_group_count() {\n                        if group_id == plan.chosen_group {\n                            continue; // Skip the already-tried group\n                        }\n\n                        if let Some(group) = topology.group(group_id) {\n                            let replicas = crate::router::assign_shard_in_group(\n                                shard_id,\n                                group.nodes(),\n                                topology.rf(),\n                            );\n                            if replicas.is_empty() {\n                                continue;\n                            }\n\n                            // Try each replica in the fallback group\n                            for node_id in replicas {\n                                if let Some(node) = topology.node(&node_id) {\n                                    match client.search_node(&node_id, &node.address, &req).await {\n                                        Ok(body) => {\n                                            fallback_pages.push(ShardHitPage { body });\n                                            fallback_succeeded = true;\n                                            break;\n                                        }\n                                        Err(_) => {\n                                            continue; // Try next replica\n                                        }\n                                    }\n                                }\n                            }\n\n                            if fallback_succeeded {\n                                break; // Found a working replica\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n\n                    if !fallback_succeeded {\n                        remaining_failed.insert(shard_id, error.clone());\n                    }\n                }\n\n                // Merge fallback results\n                shard_pages.extend(fallback_pages);\n\n                // Update failed_shards with only those that truly failed\n                if remaining_failed.is_empty() {\n                    // All shards succeeded via fallback\n                    return Ok(ScatterResult {\n                        shard_pages,\n                        failed_shards: HashMap::new(),\n                        partial: false,\n                        deadline_exceeded,\n                    });\n                } else {\n                    // Some shards still failed\n                    failed_shards = remaining_failed;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    Ok(ScatterResult {\n        shard_pages,\n        failed_shards,\n        partial,\n        deadline_exceeded,\n    })\n}\n\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(index = %req.index_uid))]\npub async fn scatter_gather_search<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    policy: UnavailableShardPolicy,\n    strategy: &dyn MergeStrategy,\n) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let scatter_result = execute_scatter(plan, client, req.clone(), topology, policy).await?;\n\n    let mut shard_pages = scatter_result.shard_pages;\n    if scatter_result.partial {\n        for shard_id in scatter_result.failed_shards.keys() {\n            shard_pages.push(ShardHitPage {\n                body: serde_json::json!({\"success\": false, \"message\": format!(\"shard {} unavailable\", shard_id)}),\n            });\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Collect failed shard IDs for the X-Miroir-Degraded header\n    let failed_shards: Vec<u32> = scatter_result.failed_shards.keys().copied().collect();\n\n    let merge_input = MergeInput {\n        shard_hits: shard_pages,\n        offset: req.offset,\n        limit: req.limit,\n        client_requested_score: req.ranking_score,\n        facets: req.facets.clone(),\n        failed_shards,\n        vector_mode: req.vector_mode,\n        vector_config: req.vector_config.clone(),\n    };\n\n    // Span for the merge operation\n    let _span = info_span!(\n        \"merge\",\n        shard_count = merge_input.shard_hits.len(),\n        offset = req.offset,\n        limit = req.limit,\n    )\n    .entered();\n\n    strategy.merge(merge_input)\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// OP#4: Global-IDF preflight execution\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Extract unique query terms from a search query string.\npub fn extract_query_terms(query: &Option<String>) -> Vec<String> {\n    match query {\n        Some(q) if !q.is_empty() => {\n            let mut seen = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n            let mut terms = Vec::new();\n            for term in q.split_whitespace() {\n                let lower = term.to_lowercase();\n                if seen.insert(lower.clone()) {\n                    terms.push(lower);\n                }\n            }\n            terms\n        }\n        _ => Vec::new(),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Execute the preflight phase: gather term frequencies from all shards.\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(node_count, term_count = req.terms.len()))]\npub async fn execute_preflight<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: &ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: &PreflightRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n) -> Result<GlobalIdf> {\n    if req.terms.is_empty() {\n        return Ok(GlobalIdf {\n            total_docs: 0,\n            avg_doc_length: 0.0,\n            terms: HashMap::new(),\n        });\n    }\n\n    let mut node_to_shards: HashMap<NodeId, Vec<u32>> = HashMap::new();\n    for (&shard_id, node_id) in &plan.shard_to_node {\n        if plan.target_shards.contains(&shard_id) {\n            node_to_shards\n                .entry(node_id.clone())\n                .or_default()\n                .push(shard_id);\n        }\n    }\n\n    let mut tasks = Vec::new();\n    for (node_id, _) in node_to_shards {\n        let node = match topology.node(&node_id) {\n            Some(n) => n.clone(),\n            None => continue,\n        };\n        let client_ref = client;\n        let req_clone = req.clone();\n        let nid = node_id.clone();\n        tasks.push(async move {\n            client_ref\n                .preflight_node(&nid, &node.address, &req_clone)\n                .await\n        });\n    }\n\n    let results = futures_util::future::join_all(tasks).await;\n    let responses: Vec<PreflightResponse> = results.into_iter().filter_map(|r| r.ok()).collect();\n    Ok(GlobalIdf::from_preflight_responses(&responses))\n}\n\n/// Execute a full dfs_query_then_fetch search (OP#4 global-IDF preflight).\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(index = %req.index_uid))]\npub async fn dfs_query_then_fetch_search<C: NodeClient>(\n    plan: ScatterPlan,\n    client: &C,\n    req: SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    policy: UnavailableShardPolicy,\n    strategy: &dyn MergeStrategy,\n) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let preflight_req = PreflightRequest {\n        index_uid: req.index_uid.clone(),\n        terms: extract_query_terms(&req.query),\n        filter: req.filter.clone(),\n    };\n    let global_idf = execute_preflight(&plan, client, &preflight_req, topology).await?;\n    let mut search_req = req;\n    search_req.global_idf = Some(global_idf);\n    scatter_gather_search(plan, client, search_req, topology, policy, strategy).await\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// §13.2 Hedged requests for tail-latency mitigation\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Execute a single node request with hedging support.\n///\n/// If hedging is enabled and the primary request exceeds the p95 deadline,\n/// a duplicate request is sent to an alternate replica. The first response wins.\n#[instrument(skip_all, fields(node_id = %primary_node, shard_id))]\n#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]\npub async fn execute_hedged_request<C: NodeClient>(\n    client: &C,\n    primary_node: &NodeId,\n    primary_address: &str,\n    shard_id: u32,\n    req: &SearchRequest,\n    topology: &Topology,\n    hedging_manager: Option<&HedgingManager>,\n    hedge_count: &mut u32,\n) -> (\n    std::result::Result<Value, NodeError>,\n    Option<HedgeOutcome>,\n    Duration,\n) {\n    let start = Instant::now();\n\n    // Check if hedging is enabled and we haven't exceeded the budget\n    let hedge_deadline = if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n        if *hedge_count < manager.config().max_hedges_per_query {\n            let deadline = manager.hedge_deadline(primary_node).await;\n            tracing::debug!(\"Hedge deadline for {:?}: {:?}\", primary_node, deadline);\n            deadline\n        } else {\n            tracing::debug!(\n                \"Hedge budget exhausted: {} >= {}\",\n                *hedge_count,\n                manager.config().max_hedges_per_query\n            );\n            None\n        }\n    } else {\n        tracing::debug!(\"Hedging disabled (no manager)\");\n        None\n    };\n\n    match hedge_deadline {\n        Some(deadline) => {\n            // Hedging enabled: try primary with timeout, then hedge\n            //\n            // The key insight: we want to cancel the primary if it's too slow\n            // and the hedge completes successfully. We use tokio::select! with\n            // a timeout to achieve this.\n\n            // First, try the primary with a timeout equal to the hedge deadline\n            let primary_result = tokio::time::timeout(\n                deadline,\n                client.search_node(primary_node, primary_address, req),\n            )\n            .await;\n\n            match primary_result {\n                Ok(Ok(value)) => {\n                    // Primary completed within deadline - no hedge needed\n                    let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n                    tracing::debug!(\"Primary completed within deadline {:?}\", elapsed);\n\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                        manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n                    }\n\n                    (Ok(value), None, elapsed)\n                }\n                Ok(Err(err)) => {\n                    // Primary failed within deadline - return error\n                    let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n                    tracing::debug!(\"Primary failed within deadline {:?}\", elapsed);\n\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                        manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n                    }\n\n                    (Err(err), None, elapsed)\n                }\n                Err(_) => {\n                    // Primary timed out - try hedge\n                    tracing::debug!(\"Primary timed out after {:?}, trying hedge\", deadline);\n\n                    // Find an alternate replica\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        if let Some(alternate_node) = manager\n                            .find_alternate(primary_node, shard_id, *hedge_count)\n                            .await\n                        {\n                            *hedge_count += 1;\n                            tracing::debug!(\"Hedge sending to {:?}\", alternate_node);\n\n                            if let Some(node) = topology.node(&alternate_node) {\n                                let hedge_start = Instant::now();\n                                let hedge_result = client\n                                    .search_node(&alternate_node, &node.address, req)\n                                    .await;\n                                let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n\n                                // Record latency for primary (it timed out)\n                                manager\n                                    .record_latency(primary_node, deadline.as_millis() as f64)\n                                    .await;\n\n                                match &hedge_result {\n                                    Ok(_) => {\n                                        tracing::debug!(\n                                            \"Hedge to {:?} succeeded in {:?}\",\n                                            alternate_node,\n                                            hedge_start.elapsed()\n                                        );\n                                    }\n                                    Err(e) => {\n                                        tracing::debug!(\n                                            \"Hedge to {:?} failed: {:?}\",\n                                            alternate_node,\n                                            e\n                                        );\n                                    }\n                                }\n\n                                return (hedge_result, Some(HedgeOutcome::HedgeWon), elapsed);\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n\n                    // No alternate available - wait for primary to complete\n                    tracing::debug!(\"No alternate available, waiting for primary\");\n                    let primary_result =\n                        client.search_node(primary_node, primary_address, req).await;\n                    let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n\n                    if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                        let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                        manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n                    }\n\n                    (primary_result, Some(HedgeOutcome::PrimaryWon), elapsed)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        None => {\n            // No hedging - execute primary request only\n            let result = client.search_node(primary_node, primary_address, req).await;\n            let elapsed = start.elapsed();\n\n            // Record latency observation\n            if let Some(manager) = hedging_manager {\n                let latency_ms = elapsed.as_millis() as f64;\n                manager.record_latency(primary_node, latency_ms).await;\n            }\n\n            (result, None, elapsed)\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Mock client\n// async fn test_dfs_query_then_fetch() {\n        let topo = make_test_topology();\n        let plan = plan_search_scatter(&topo, 0, 2, 64, None).await;\n        let mut c = MockNodeClient::default();\n        c.responses.insert(NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()), serde_json::json!({\"hits\": [{\"id\": \"a\", \"_rankingScore\": 0.9}], \"estimatedTotalHits\": 1, \"processingTimeMs\": 5}));\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 50000,\n                avg_doc_length: 50.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([(\"test\".into(), TermStats { df: 500 })]),\n            },\n        );\n        let s = crate::merger::RrfStrategy::default_strategy();\n        let r = dfs_query_then_fetch_search(\n            plan,\n            &c,\n            make_req(),\n            &topo,\n            UnavailableShardPolicy::Partial,\n            &s,\n        )\n        .await\n        .unwrap();\n        assert!(!r.degraded);\n        assert!(!r.hits.is_empty());\n    }\n\n    /// Integration test for dfs_query_then_fetch with severely skewed shard distribution.\n    ///\n    /// This test simulates the scenario described in miroir-yio:\n    /// - Shard 0: Normal (1,000 docs, term df = 100)\n    /// - Shard 1: 100x normal (100,000 docs, term df = 10,000)\n    /// - Shard 2: Near-empty (10 docs, term df = 1)\n    ///\n    /// Without global IDF preflight, each shard would compute different local IDF values:\n    /// - Shard 0: IDF ≈ log((1000 - 100 + 0.5) / (100 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n    /// - Shard 1: IDF ≈ log((100000 - 10000 + 0.5) / (10000 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n    /// - Shard 2: IDF ≈ log((10 - 1 + 0.5) / (1 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.8\n    ///\n    /// With global IDF preflight, all shards use the same IDF:\n    /// - Global: N = 101,010, df = 10,101\n    /// - IDF ≈ log((101010 - 10101 + 0.5) / (10101 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.3\n    ///\n    /// This ensures scores are comparable across shards, enabling correct score-based merge.\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn test_dfs_skewed_shards_global_idf_aggregation() {\n        let mut topo = Topology::new(3, 1, 1);\n        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n            \"http://node-0:7700\".into(),\n            0,\n        ));\n        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-1\".into()),\n            \"http://node-1:7700\".into(),\n            0,\n        ));\n        topo.add_node(Node::new(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-2\".into()),\n            \"http://node-2:7700\".into(),\n            0,\n        ));\n\n        let plan = plan_search_scatter(&topo, 0, 1, 3, None).await;\n\n        // Simulate severely skewed shard distribution\n        let mut c = MockNodeClient::default();\n\n        // Shard 0: Normal distribution\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-0\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 1000,\n                avg_doc_length: 50.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 100 }),\n                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 80 }),\n                ]),\n            },\n        );\n\n        // Shard 1: 100x normal (severely skewed)\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-1\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 100_000,\n                avg_doc_length: 55.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 10_000 }),\n                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 8_000 }),\n                ]),\n            },\n        );\n\n        // Shard 2: Near-empty\n        c.preflight_responses.insert(\n            NodeId::new(\"node-2\".into()),\n            PreflightResponse {\n                total_docs: 10,\n                avg_doc_length: 45.0,\n                term_stats: HashMap::from([\n                    (\"machine\".into(), TermStats { df: 1 }),\n                    (\"learning\".into(), TermStats { df: 1 }),\n                ]),\n            },\n        );\n\n        // Execute preflight to get global IDF\n        let preflight_req = PreflightRequest {\n            index_uid: \"test\".into(),\n            terms: vec![\"machine\".into(), \"learning\".into()],\n            filter: None,\n        };\n\n        let global_idf = execute_preflight(&plan, &c, &preflight_req, &topo)\n            .await\n            .unwrap();\n\n        // Verify global aggregation\n        assert_eq!(global_idf.total_docs, 101_010);\n        assert_eq!(global_idf.terms.get(\"machine\").unwrap().df, 10_101);\n        assert_eq!(global_idf.terms.get(\"learning\").unwrap().df, 8_081);\n\n        // Verify global IDF is the same for all shards\n        // Expected IDF for \"machine\": log((101010 - 10101 + 0.5) / (10101 + 0.5)) + 1\n        let expected_idf_machine: f64 =\n            ((101010.0_f64 - 10101.0 + 0.5) / (10101.0 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0;\n        let actual_idf_machine = global_idf.terms.get(\"machine\").unwrap().idf;\n        assert!((actual_idf_machine - expected_idf_machine).abs() < 0.001);\n\n        // Expected IDF for \"learning\": log((101010 - 8081 + 0.5) / (8081 + 0.5)) + 1\n        let expected_idf_learning: f64 =\n            ((101010.0_f64 - 8081.0 + 0.5) / (8081.0 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0;\n        let actual_idf_learning = global_idf.terms.get(\"learning\").unwrap().idf;\n        assert!((actual_idf_learning - expected_idf_learning).abs() < 0.001);\n\n        // Verify that without global IDF, local IDF values would differ significantly\n        // Shard 0 local IDF for \"machine\": log((1000 - 100 + 0.5) / (100 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 3.19\n        // Shard 1 local IDF for \"machine\": log((100000 - 10000 + 0.5) / (10000 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 3.20\n        // Shard 2 local IDF for \"machine\": log((10 - 1 + 0.5) / (1 + 0.5)) + 1 ≈ 2.85\n        let local_idf_shard_0: f64 = ((1000.0_f64 - 100.0 + 0.5) / (100.0 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0;\n        let local_idf_shard_2: f64 = ((10.0_f64 - 1.0 + 0.5) / (1.0 + 0.5)).ln() + 1.0;\n        assert!(\n            (local_idf_shard_2 - local_idf_shard_0).abs() > 0.2,\n            \"Local IDF values should differ significantly\"\n        );\n        assert!(\n            (local_idf_shard_2 - actual_idf_machine).abs() > 0.3,\n            \"Global IDF should be closer to large-shard local IDF\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    /// Test that DFS preflight handles empty query terms gracefully.\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn test_dfs_empty_query_terms() {\n        let topo = for deduplication.\n271\t                    let primary_key = map\n272\t                        .get(\"id\")\n273\t                        .or_else(|| map.get(\"pk\"))\n274\t                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n275\t                        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n276\t                        .to_string();\n277\t\n278\t                    // RRF contribution: 1 / (k + rank + 1)\n279\t                    // rank is 0-based, so +1 converts to 1-based position.\n280\t                    let rrf_contribution = 1.0 / ((*k as f64) + (rank as f64) + 1.0);\n281\t\n282\t                    // Aggregate RRF scores across shards.\n283\t                    use std::collections::hash_map::Entry;\n284\t                    match rrf_map.entry(primary_key.clone()) {\n285\t                        Entry::Vacant(e) => {\n286\t                            e.insert(RRFDocument {\n287\t                                rrf_score: rrf_contribution,\n288\t                                primary_key,\n289\t                                hit: map,\n290\t                            });\n291\t                        }\n292\t                        Entry::Occupied(mut e) => {\n293\t                            // Document appears in multiple shards: sum RRF contributions.\n294\t                            e.get_mut().rrf_score += rrf_contribution;\n295\t                        }\n296\t                    }\n297\t                }\n298\t            }\n299\t        }\n300\t    }\n301\t\n302\t    // Convert map to vec and sort by RRF score descending.\n303\t    let mut merged_docs: Vec<_> = rrf_map.into_values().collect();\n304\t    merged_docs.sort();\n305\t\n306\t    // Apply offset + limit.\n307\t    let skip = input.offset;\n308\t    let take = input.limit;\n309\t    let paginated_hits: Vec<_> = merged_docs.into_iter().skip(skip).take(take).collect();\n310\t\n311\t    // Strip reserved fields and rebuild hits.\n312\t    let mut hits = Vec::with_capacity(paginated_hits.len());\n313\t    for mut doc in paginated_hits {\n314\t        // Strip _rankingScore if not requested (RRF doesn't use original scores).\n315\t        if !input.client_requested_score {\n316\t            doc.hit.remove(\"_rankingScore\");\n317\t        }\n318\t\n319\t        // Always strip _miroir_* fields.\n320\t        doc.hit.retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with(\"_miroir_\"));\n321\t\n322\t        hits.push(Value::Object(doc.hit));\n323\t    }\n324\t\n325\t    // Merge facets.\n326\t    let facet_distribution = merge_facets(&input.shard_hits, input.facets.as_deref());\n327\t\n328\t    Ok(MergedSearchResult {\n329\t        hits,\n330\t        facet_distribution,\n331\t        estimated_total_hits,\n332\t        processing_time_ms: max_processing_time,\n333\t        degraded,\n334\t        failed_shards: input.failed_shards,\n335\t    })\n336\t}\n337\t\n338\t/// Score-based merge strategy (OP#4 global-IDF).\n339\t///\n340\t/// This merge strategy is correct **only when** the preflight phase has\n341\t/// provided global IDF so that scores are comparable across shards. It sorts\n342\t/// all hits globally by `_rankingScore` descending, with deterministic\n343\t/// tie-breaking on primary key.\n344\t///\n345\t/// Without global IDF, this strategy will produce incorrect rankings because\n346\t/// shard-local scores are not comparable across shards with different document\n347\t/// distributions.\n348\t///\n349\t/// Use with [`dfs_query_then_fetch_search`] in the scatter module.\n350\t#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\n351\tpub struct ScoreMergeStrategy;\n352\t\n353\timpl ScoreMergeStrategy {\n354\t    /// Create a new score-based merge strategy.\n355\t    pub fn new() -> Self {\n356\t        Self\n357\t    }\n358\t}\n359\t\n360\timpl Default for ScoreMergeStrategy {\n361\t    fn default() -> Self {\n362\t        Self::new()\n363\t    }\n364\t}\n365\t\n366\timpl MergeStrategy for ScoreMergeStrategy {\n367\t    fn merge(&self, input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n368\t        score_merge(input)\n369\t    }\n370\t\n371\t    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n372\t        \"score\"\n373\t    }\n374\t}\n375\t\n376\t/// Core score-based merge implementation (OP#4 global-IDF).\n377\t///\n378\t/// This merge strategy is correct when the preflight phase has provided\n379\t/// global IDF so that scores are comparable across shards. It sorts all\n380\t/// hits globally by `_rankingScore` descending, with deterministic tie-breaking\n381\t/// on primary key.\n382\t///\n383\t/// Without global IDF, this strategy will produce incorrect rankings because\n384\t/// shard-local scores are not comparable across shards with different document\n385\t/// distributions.\n386\tfn score_merge(input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n387\t    let mut estimated_total_hits = 0u64;\n388\t    let mut max_processing_time = 0u64;\n389\t    let mut degraded = false;\n390\t    let mut seen_pks = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n391\t    let mut all_hits = Vec::new();\n392\t\n393\t    // Collect all hits from all shards, deduplicating by primary key.\n394\t    // Dedup is needed because execute_scatter may push the same node response\n395\t    // once per shard when multiple shards map to the same node.\n396\t    for shard_page in &input.shard_hits {\n397\t        let body = &shard_page.body;\n398\t\n399\t        // Check for degraded response.\n400\t        if let Some(serde_json::Value::Bool(false)) = body.get(\"success\") {\n401\t            degraded = true;\n402\t            continue;\n403\t        }\n404\t\n405\t        // Extract estimated total hits.\n406\t        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"estimatedTotalHits\") {\n407\t            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n408\t                estimated_total_hits = estimated_total_hits.saturating_add(n);\n409\t            }\n410\t        }\n411\t\n412\t        // Extract processing time.\n413\t        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"processingTimeMs\") {\n414\t            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n415\t                max_processing_time = max_processing_time.max(n);\n416\t            }\n417\t        }\n418\t\n419\t        // Extract hits.\n420\t        if let Some(Value::Array(hits)) = body.get(\"hits\") {\n421\t            for hit in hits {\n422\t                if let Value::Object(map) = hit {\n423\t                    let pk = map\n424\t                        .get(\"id\")\n425\t                        .or_else(|| map.get(\"pk\"))\n426\t                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n427\t                        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n428\t                        .to_string();\n429\t                    if seen_pks.insert(pk) {\n430\t                        all_hits.push(map.clone());\n431\t                    }\n432\t                }\n433\t            }\n434\t        }\n435\t    }\n436\t\n437\t    // Sort by score descending, then by primary key ascending for tie-breaking.\n438\t    all_hits.sort_by(|a, b| {\n439\t        let score_a = a\n440\t            .get(\"_rankingScore\")\n441\t            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())\n442\t            .unwrap_or(0.0);\n443\t        let score_b = b\n444\t            .get(\"_rankingScore\")\n445\t            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())\n446\t            .unwrap_or(0.0);\n447\t\n448\t        // Extract primary keys for tie-breaking.\n449\t        let pk_a = a\n450\t            .get(\"id\")\n451\t            .or_else(|| a.get(\"pk\"))\n452\t            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n453\t            .unwrap_or(\"\");\n454\t        let pk_b = b\n455\t            .get(\"id\")\n456\t            .or_else(|| b.get(\"pk\"))\n457\t            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n458\t            .unwrap_or(\"\");\n459\t\n460\t        // Primary sort: score descending (higher score = better rank)\n461\t        match score_a.partial_cmp(&score_b) {\n462\t            Some(Ordering::Equal) => {\n463\t                // Secondary sort: primary key ascending for deterministic tie-breaking\n464\t                pk_a.cmp(pk_b)\n465\t            }\n466\t            Some(ord) => ord.reverse(),\n467\t            None => {\n468\t                // NaN case: treat as lowest score\n469\t                if score_a.is_nan() && !score_b.is_nan() {\n470\t                    Ordering::Less\n471\t                } else if !score_a.is_nan() && score_b.is_nan() {\n472\t                    Ordering::Greater\n473\t                } else {\n474\t                    Ordering::Equal\n475\t                }\n476\t            }\n477\t        }\n478\t    });\n479\t\n480\t    // Apply offset + limit.\n481\t    let paginated_hits: Vec<_> = all_hits\n482\t        .into_iter()\n483\t        .skip(input.offset)\n484\t        .take(input.limit)\n485\t        .collect();\n486\t\n487\t    // Strip reserved fields and rebuild hits.\n488\t    let mut hits = Vec::with_capacity(paginated_hits.len());\n489\t    for mut hit in paginated_hits {\n490\t        // Strip _rankingScore if not requested.\n491\t        if !input.client_requested_score {\n492\t            hit.remove(\"_rankingScore\");\n493\t        }\n494\t\n495\t        // Always strip _miroir_* fields.\n496\t        hit.retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with(\"_miroir_\"));\n497\t\n498\t        hits.push(Value::Object(hit));\n499\t    }\n500\t\n501\t    // Merge facets.\n502\t    let facet_distribution = merge_facets(&input.shard_hits, input.facets.as_deref());\n503\t\n504\t    Ok(MergedSearchResult {\n505\t        hits,\n506\t        facet_distribution,\n507\t        estimated_total_hits,\n508\t        processing_time_ms: max_processing_time,\n509\t        degraded,\n510\t        failed_shards: input.failed_shards,\n511\t    })\n512\t}\n513\t\n514\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n515\t// Vector merge strategy (plan §13.12)\n516\t// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n517\t\n518\t/// Vector-aware merge strategy for hybrid search (plan §13.12).\n519\t#[derive(Debug, input: MergeInput,\n) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    strategy.merge(input)\n}\n\n/// Core RRF merge implementation.\nfn rrf_merge(k: &u32, input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let mut estimated_total_hits = 0u64;\n    let mut max_processing_time = 0u64;\n    let mut degraded = false;\n\n    // Collect all hits with their ranks from all shards.\n    // Use a map to aggregate RRF scores for documents appearing in multiple shards.\n    let mut rrf_map: std::collections::HashMap<String, RRFDocument> =\n        std::collections::HashMap::new();\n\n    for shard_page in &input.shard_hits {\n        let body = &shard_page.body;\n\n        // Check for degraded response.\n        if let Some(serde_json::Value::Bool(false)) = body.get(\"success\") {\n            degraded = true;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Extract estimated total hits.\n        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"estimatedTotalHits\") {\n            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                estimated_total_hits = estimated_total_hits.saturating_add(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract processing time.\n        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"processingTimeMs\") {\n            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                max_processing_time = max_processing_time.max(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract hits with ranks (position in shard's results).\n        if let Some(Value::Array(hits)) = body.get(\"hits\") {\n            for (rank, hit) in hits.iter().enumerate() {\n                if let Value::Object(ref map) = hit {\n                    let map = map.clone();\n\n                    // Extract primary key for deduplication.\n                    let primary_key = map\n                        .get(\"id\")\n                        .or_else(|| map.get(\"pk\"))\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                        .to_string();\n\n                    // RRF contribution: 1 / (k + rank + 1)\n                    // rank is 0-based, so +1 converts to 1-based position.\n                    let rrf_contribution = 1.0 / ((*k as f64) + (rank as f64) + 1.0);\n\n                    // Aggregate RRF scores across shards.\n                    use std::collections::hash_map::Entry;\n                    match rrf_map.entry(primary_key.clone()) {\n                        Entry::Vacant(e) => {\n                            e.insert(RRFDocument {\n                                rrf_score: rrf_contribution,\n                                primary_key,\n                                hit: map,\n                            });\n                        }\n                        Entry::Occupied(mut e) => {\n                            // Document appears in multiple shards: sum RRF contributions.\n                            e.get_mut().rrf_score += rrf_contribution;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Convert map to vec and sort by RRF score descending.\n    let mut merged_docs: Vec<_> = rrf_map.into_values().collect();\n    merged_docs.sort();\n\n    // Apply offset + limit.\n    let skip = input.offset;\n    let take = input.limit;\n    let paginated_hits: Vec<_> = merged_docs.into_iter().skip(skip).take(take).collect();\n\n    // Strip reserved fields and rebuild hits.\n    let mut hits = Vec::with_capacity(paginated_hits.len());\n    for mut doc in paginated_hits {\n        // Strip _rankingScore if not requested (RRF doesn't use original scores).\n        if !input.client_requested_score {\n            doc.hit.remove(\"_rankingScore\");\n        }\n\n        // Always strip _miroir_* fields.\n        doc.hit.retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with(\"_miroir_\"));\n\n        hits.push(Value::Object(doc.hit));\n    }\n\n    // Merge facets.\n    let facet_distribution = merge_facets(&input.shard_hits, input.facets.as_deref());\n\n    Ok(MergedSearchResult {\n        hits,\n        facet_distribution,\n        estimated_total_hits,\n        processing_time_ms: max_processing_time,\n        degraded,\n        failed_shards: input.failed_shards,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Score-based merge strategy (OP#4 global-IDF).\n///\n/// This merge strategy is correct **only when** the preflight phase has\n/// provided global IDF so that scores are comparable across shards. It sorts\n/// all hits globally by `_rankingScore` descending, with deterministic\n/// tie-breaking on primary key.\n///\n/// Without global IDF, this strategy will produce incorrect rankings because\n/// shard-local scores are not comparable across shards with different document\n/// distributions.\n///\n/// Use with [`dfs_query_then_fetch_search`] in the scatter module.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy)]\npub struct ScoreMergeStrategy;\n\nimpl ScoreMergeStrategy {\n    /// Create a new score-based merge strategy.\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for ScoreMergeStrategy {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::new()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl MergeStrategy for ScoreMergeStrategy {\n    fn merge(&self, input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n        score_merge(input)\n    }\n\n    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n        \"score\"\n    }\n}\n\n/// Core score-based merge implementation (OP#4 global-IDF).\n///\n/// This merge strategy is correct when the preflight phase has provided\n/// global IDF so that scores are comparable across shards. It sorts all\n/// hits globally by `_rankingScore` descending, with deterministic tie-breaking\n/// on primary key.\n///\n/// Without global IDF, this strategy will produce incorrect rankings because\n/// shard-local scores are not comparable across shards with different document\n/// distributions.\nfn score_merge(input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let mut estimated_total_hits = 0u64;\n    let mut max_processing_time = 0u64;\n    let mut degraded = false;\n    let mut seen_pks = std::collections::HashSet::new();\n    let mut all_hits = Vec::new();\n\n    // Collect all hits from all shards, deduplicating by primary key.\n    // Dedup is needed because execute_scatter may push the same node response\n    // once per shard when multiple shards map to the same node.\n    for shard_page in &input.shard_hits {\n        let body = &shard_page.body;\n\n        // Check for degraded response.\n        if let Some(serde_json::Value::Bool(false)) = body.get(\"success\") {\n            degraded = true;\n            continue;\n        }\n\n        // Extract estimated total hits.\n        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"estimatedTotalHits\") {\n            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                estimated_total_hits = estimated_total_hits.saturating_add(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract processing time.\n        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"processingTimeMs\") {\n            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                max_processing_time = max_processing_time.max(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Extract hits.\n        if let Some(Value::Array(hits)) = body.get(\"hits\") {\n            for hit in hits {\n                if let Value::Object(map) = hit {\n                    let pk = map\n                        .get(\"id\")\n                        .or_else(|| map.get(\"pk\"))\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                        .to_string();\n                    if seen_pks.insert(pk) {\n                        all_hits.push(map.clone());\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Sort by score descending, then by primary key ascending for tie-breaking.\n    all_hits.sort_by(|a, b| {\n        let score_a = a\n            .get(\"_rankingScore\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())\n            .unwrap_or(0.0);\n        let score_b = b\n            .get(\"_rankingScore\")\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())\n            .unwrap_or(0.0);\n\n        // Extract primary keys for tie-breaking.\n        let pk_a = a\n            .get(\"id\")\n            .or_else(|| a.get(\"pk\"))\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n            .unwrap_or(\"\");\n        let pk_b = b\n            .get(\"id\")\n            .or_else(|| b.get(\"pk\"))\n            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n            .unwrap_or(\"\");\n\n        // Primary sort: score descending (higher score = better rank)\n        match score_a.partial_cmp(&score_b) {\n            Some(Ordering::Equal) => {\n                // Secondary sort: primary key ascending for deterministic tie-breaking\n                pk_a.cmp(pk_b)\n            }\n            Some(ord) => ord.reverse(),\n            None => {\n                // NaN case: treat as lowest score\n                if score_a.is_nan() && !score_b.is_nan() {\n                    Ordering::Less\n                } else if !score_a.is_nan() && score_b.is_nan() {\n                    Ordering::Greater\n                } else {\n                    Ordering::Equal\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    });\n\n    // Apply offset + limit.\n    let paginated_hits: Vec<_> = all_hits\n        .into_iter()\n        .skip(input.offset)\n        .take(input.limit)\n        .collect();\n\n    // Strip reserved fields and rebuild hits.\n    let mut hits = Vec::with_capacity(paginated_hits.len());\n    for mut hit in paginated_hits {\n        // Strip _rankingScore if not requested.\n        if !input.client_requested_score {\n            hit.remove(\"_rankingScore\");\n        }\n\n        // Always strip _miroir_* fields.\n        hit.retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with(\"_miroir_\"));\n\n        hits.push(Value::Object(hit));\n    }\n\n    // Merge facets.\n    let facet_distribution = merge_facets(&input.shard_hits, input.facets.as_deref());\n\n    Ok(MergedSearchResult {\n        hits,\n        facet_distribution,\n        estimated_total_hits,\n        processing_time_ms: max_processing_time,\n        degraded,\n        failed_shards: input.failed_shards,\n    })\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Vector merge strategy (plan §13.12)\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Vector-aware merge strategy for hybrid search (plan §13.12).\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct VectorMergeStrategy {\n    merger: VectorMerger,\n}\n\nimpl VectorMergeStrategy {\n    pub fn new(config: &VectorSearchConfig) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            merger: VectorMerger::new(config),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn default_strategy() -> Self {\n        Self::new(&VectorSearchConfig::default())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for VectorMergeStrategy {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::default_strategy()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl MergeStrategy for VectorMergeStrategy {\n    fn merge(&self, input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n        vector_merge(&self.merger, &input)\n    }\n\n    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n        \"vector\"\n    }\n}\n\nfn vector_merge(merger: &VectorMerger, input: &MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n    let mut estimated_total_hits = 0u64;\n    let mut max_processing_time = 0u64;\n    let degraded = !input.failed_shards.is_empty();\n    let mut shard_hits = Vec::new();\n\n    for shard_page in &input.shard_hits {\n        let body = &shard_page.body;\n\n        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"estimatedTotalHits\") {\n            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                estimated_total_hits = estimated_total_hits.saturating_add(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(Value::Number(n)) = body.get(\"processingTimeMs\") {\n            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                max_processing_time = max_processing_time.max(n);\n            }\n        }\n\n        if let Some(Value::Array(hits)) = body.get(\"hits\") {\n            for hit in hits {\n                if let Value::Object(map) = hit {\n                    let pk = map\n                        .get(\"id\")\n                        .or_else(|| map.get(\"pk\"))\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                        .unwrap_or(\"\")\n                        .to_string();\n\n                    let ranking_score = map\n                        .get(\"_rankingScore\")\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_f64())\n                        .unwrap_or(0.0);\n\n                    let semantic_score = map.get(\"_semanticScore\").and_then(|v| v.as_f64());\n\n                    let shard_id = map\n                        .get(\"_miroir_shard\")\n                        .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())\n                        .unwrap_or(0) as u32;\n\n                    let vector_hit = match input.vector_mode {\n                        VectorMode::KeywordOnly => {\n                            VectorHit::bm25_only(pk, ranking_score, shard_id)\n                        }\n                        VectorMode::VectorOnly => {\n                            let semantic = semantic_score.unwrap_or(0.0);\n                            let mut hit = VectorHit::bm25_only(pk, semantic, shard_id);\n                            hit.semantic_score = Some(semantic);\n                            hit.combined_score = semantic;\n                            hit\n                        }\n                        VectorMode::Hybrid => {\n                            if let Some(semantic) = semantic_score {\n                                VectorHit::hybrid(pk, ranking_score, semantic, shard_id)\n                            } else {\n                                VectorHit::bm25_only(pk, ranking_score, shard_id)\n                            }\n                        }\n                    };\n\n                    shard_hits.push((shard_id, vector_hit));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    let merged_hits = merger.merge(shard_hits, input.limit + input.offset);\n    let paginated_hits: Vec<_> = merged_hits\n        .into_iter()\n        .skip(input.offset)\n        .take(input.limit)\n        .collect();\n\n    let mut hits = Vec::with_capacity(paginated_hits.len());\n    for doc in paginated_hits {\n        let mut hit_map = Map::new();\n        hit_map.insert(\"id\".to_string(), Value::String(doc.pk.clone()));\n\n        if input.client_requested_score {\n            hit_map.insert(\n                \"_rankingScore\".to_string(),\n                Value::Number(\n                    serde_json::Number::from_f64(doc.ranking_score)\n                        .unwrap_or_else(|| serde_json::Number::from(0)),\n                ),\n            );\n        }\n\n        if input.client_requested_score {\n            if let Some(semantic) = doc.semantic_score {\n                hit_map.insert(\n                    \"_semanticScore\".to_string(),\n                    Value::Number(\n                        serde_json::Number::from_f64(semantic)\n                            .unwrap_or_else(|| serde_json::Number::from(0)),\n                    ),\n                );\n            }\n        }\n\n        hit_map.retain(|k, _| !k.starts_with(\"_miroir_\"));\n        hits.push(Value::Object(hit_map));\n    }\n\n    let facet_distribution = merge_facets(&input.shard_hits, input.facets.as_deref());\n\n    Ok(MergedSearchResult {\n        hits,\n        facet_distribution,\n        estimated_total_hits,\n        processing_time_ms: max_processing_time,\n        degraded,\n        failed_shards: input.failed_shards.clone(),\n    })\n}\n\n/// Adaptive merge strategy that selects vector or score merge based on mode.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct AdaptiveMergeStrategy {\n    vector_strategy: VectorMergeStrategy,\n    score_strategy: ScoreMergeStrategy,\n}\n\nimpl AdaptiveMergeStrategy {\n    pub fn new(vector_config: &VectorSearchConfig) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            vector_strategy: VectorMergeStrategy::new(vector_config),\n            score_strategy: ScoreMergeStrategy::new(),\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn default_strategy() -> Self {\n        Self::new(&VectorSearchConfig::default())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Default for AdaptiveMergeStrategy {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Self::default_strategy()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl MergeStrategy for AdaptiveMergeStrategy {\n    fn merge(&self, input: MergeInput) -> Result<MergedSearchResult> {\n        match input.vector_mode {\n            VectorMode::KeywordOnly => self.score_strategy.merge(input),\n            VectorMode::VectorOnly | VectorMode::Hybrid => self.vector_strategy.merge(input),\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn name(&self) -> &'static str {\n        \"adaptive\"\n    }\n}\n\n/// Merge facet distributions from multiple shards.\n///\n/// Uses BTreeMap for stable ordering (deterministic serialization).\nfn merge_facets(\n    shard_pages: &[ShardHitPage],\n    requested_facets: Option<&[String]>,\n) -> Option<BTreeMap<String, BTreeMap<String, u64>>> {\n    let mut merged: BTreeMap<String, BTreeMap<String, u64>> = BTreeMap::new();\n\n    for shard_page in shard_pages {\n        let body = &shard_page.body;\n\n        // Meilisearch uses \"facetDistribution\" for facet results.\n        if let Some(Value::Object(facets)) = body.get(\"facetDistribution\") {\n            for (facet_name, facet_values) in facets {\n                // Skip if not requested (if a filter was provided).\n                if let Some(requested) = requested_facets {\n                    if !requested.iter().any(|f| f == facet_name) {\n                        continue;\n                    }\n                }\n\n                if let Value::Object(values_map) = facet_values {\n                    let merged_facet = merged.entry(facet_name.clone()).or_default();\n                    for (value, count) in values_map {\n                        if let Value::Number(n) = count {\n                            if let Some(n) = n.as_u64() {\n                                *merged_facet.entry(value.clone()).or_insert(0) += n;\n                            }\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    if merged.is_empty() {\n        None\n    } else {\n        Some(merged)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n    use serde_json::json;\n\n    // -----------------------------------------------------------------------\n    // Trait / #[test]\n    fn test_rrf_cross_shard_replication_boost() {\n        // Key RRF property: a document appearing in multiple shards\n        // gets a higher merged score than a single-shard document,\n        // even if it ranks lower within each shard.\n        //\n        // doc-replicated: rank 5 in shard0, rank 5 in shard1\n        //   RRF = 1/(60+5+1) + 1/(60+5+1) = 2/66 ≈ 0.0303\n        // doc-single: rank 0 in shard2\n        //   RRF = 1/(60+0+1) = 1/61 ≈ 0.0164\n        //\n        // doc-replicated should rank higher.\n\n        let mut shard0 = vec![];\n        let mut shard1 = vec![];\n        for i in 0..5 {\n            shard0.push(make_hit(&format!(\"filler0-{}\", i), 0.5, 0));\n            shard1.push(make_hit(&format!(\"filler1-{}\", i), 0.5, 1));\n        }\n        shard0.push(make_hit(\"doc-replicated\", 0.1, 0));\n        shard1.push(make_hit(\"doc-replicated\", 0.1, 1));\n\n        let shard2 = vec![make_hit(\"doc-single\", 0.99, 2)];\n\n        let strategy = RrfStrategy::default_strategy();\n        let result = strategy\n            .merge(MergeInput {\n                shard_hits: vec![\n                    make_shard_response(shard0, 100, 10),\n                    make_shard_response(shard1, 100, 10),\n                    make_shard_response(shard2, 100, 10),\n                ],\n                offset: 0,\n                limit: 20,\n                client_requested_score: false,\n                facets: None,\n                failed_shards: Vec::new(),\n                vector_mode: VectorMode::KeywordOnly,\n                vector_config: None,\n            })\n            .unwrap();\n\n        let ids: Vec<_> = result\n            .hits\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|h| h.get(\"id\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()))\n            .collect();\n        let rep_pos = ids.iter().position(|&id| id == \"doc-replicated\").unwrap();\n        let single_pos = ids.iter().position(|&id| id == \"doc-single\").unwrap();\n        assert!(\n            rep_pos < single_pos,\n            \"Replicated doc at pos {} should rank above single doc at pos {}\",\n            rep_pos,\n            single_pos\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn test_rrf_immune_to_score_scale() {\n        // RRF uses rank only: scores of 0.001 vs 0.999 don't affect ordering.\n        // Two shards with wildly different score ranges should produce the\n        // same merge as two shards with uniform scores.\n        let shard_a = ShardHitPage {\n            body: json!({\n                \"hits\": [\n                    {\"id\": \"a1\", \"_rankingScore\": 0.001},\n                    {\"id\": \"a2\", \"_rankingScore\": 0.002},\n                ],\n                \"estimatedTotalHits\": 2,\n                \"processingTimeMs\": 5,\n            }),\n        };\n        let shard_b = ShardHitPage {\n            body: json!({\n                \"hits\": [\n                    {\"id\": \"b1\", \"_rankingScore\": 0.999},\n                    {\"id\": \"b2\", \"_rankingScore\": 0.998},\n                ],\n                \"estimatedTotalHits\": 2,\n                \"processingTimeMs\": 5,\n            }),\n        };\n\n        let strategy = RrfStrategy::default_strategy();\n        let result = strategy\n            .merge(MergeInput {\n                shard_hits: vec![shard_a, shard_b],\n                offset: 0,\n                limit: 10,\n                client_requested_score: false,\n                facets: None,\n                failed_shards: Vec::new(),\n                vector_mode: VectorMode::KeywordOnly,\n                vector_config: None,\n            })\n            .unwrap();\n\n        // All at rank 0 or 1 — tie-break alphabetically within each rank tier.\n        // rank 0: a1, b1 → sort by id → a1, b1\n        // rank 1: a2, b2 → sort by id → a2, b2\n        let ids: Vec<_> = result\n            .hits\n            .iter()\n            .filter_map(|h| h.get(\"id\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()))\n            .collect();\n        assert_eq!(ids, vec![\"a1\", \"b1\", \"a2\", \"b2\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn    let a = super::RRFDocument {\n            rrf_score: 1.0,\n            primary_key: \"doc1\".into(),\n            hit: Map::new(),\n        };\n        let b = super::RRFDocument {\n .enumerate()\n            .map(|(i, id)| (id.as_str(), i))\n            .collect();\n\n        let common: Vec<&str> = pos1\n            .keys()\n            .filter(|k| pos2.contains_key(*k))\n
